benchmarks.name: Omnilingual ASR paper · FLEURS-81 test mean CER (Whisper-covered languages)
benchmarks.setup: Omnilingual ASR team, arXiv:2511.09690v1, Table 5: character error rate on the FLEURS test split, averaged (unweighted) across the 81 FLEURS languages that Whisper supports; all systems run by the authors, no LM fusion for the recorded rows. CER % / 100.
caveats: Language subset is fixed to the languages Whisper covers; the body text calls the sets 'MMS-Lab-63, FLEURS-82' while the table header says MMS-Lab-66 / FLEURS-81 (header recorded).
